summary: Iteration 4 frontend testing FAILED on the critical purchase flow. Login marc@padel.fr OK. Paywall opens from profile 'Passe Premium' card (testID premium-card). Paywall renders benefits, price card ($79.99/an in Test Store — expected), restore button, confirm modal wiring. Announcement gating works: on club/[id] the default 'Annonces' tab shows NO ann-content-input for unsubscribed user (composer hidden). CRITICAL BUG (blocking): the subscribe button (testID paywall-subscribe-btn) is DISABLED (computed opacity 0.6, Pressable disabled=true) and the hint 'Préparation de ton compte…' remains visible indefinitely because identityReady stays false. Root cause visible in console: after `Purchases.logIn(user.id)` in _layout.tsx AuthGate, the returned customerInfo.originalAppUserId is still `$RCAnonymousID:2cd4c02e5a684262887d64f4fe25115f` (log line: `[RevenueCat] identity bound: $RCAnonymousID:2cd4c02e...`). On purchases-js Test Store the logIn() call returns a customerInfo whose originalAppUserId is NOT the app user id — so identityReady = !originalAppUserId?.startsWith('$RCAnonymousID:') is permanently false, the button never enables, and the user cannot complete the purchase. As a result: (a) confirm modal is unreachable via UI tap, (b) entitlement 'pro' never activates, (c) chat-input / ann-content-input never unlock, (d) profile never shows 'Premium actif'. Additional testing blocked: marc has 0 existing conversations (Messages tab empty state 'Aucune conversation'), so chat gating (chat-premium-lock) could not be verified via UI — the code path exists in /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:141 and mirrors the ann-lock pattern. Regression: clubs list (12 cards), Liste/Carte toggle, profile screen, sign-out all render fine. Deprecation warnings from iter1 (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) still present, non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: Button permanently disabled (opacity 0.6, Pressable disabled=true) with hint 'Préparation de ton compte…' showing. identityReady never becomes true on web preview because Purchases.logIn(user.id) returns customerInfo.originalAppUserId still prefixed with $RCAnonymousID: on purchases-js Test Store.

integration_issues.issue: identityReady gate blocks the whole flow. Even though _layout.tsx pushes the customerInfo from logIn() into react-query cache at ['revenuecat','customer-info'], that customerInfo.originalAppUserId is still $RCAnonymousID:*** so identityReady derived in useSubscriptionContext (revenuecat.tsx:76-77) evaluates to false. Confirmed via console log '[RevenueCat] identity bound: $RCAnonymousID:2cd4c02e5a684262887d64f4fe25115f' printed right after Purchases.logIn.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the identityReady logic so the paywall subscribe button enables on web preview. Recommended: relax the gate to accept the logIn result unconditionally — e.g. compute `identityReady = !!user?.id` (derive from useAuth) OR track a boolean `rcIdentityBound` set to true in _layout.tsx AuthGate right after Purchases.logIn() succeeds (regardless of what originalAppUserId the SDK returned), then expose that flag via SubscriptionProvider. The current derivation from customerInfo.originalAppUserId is unreliable on purchases-js Test Store.

Alternative: remove the identityReady check entirely from Paywall's disabled prop and instead surface a friendly retry inside purchaseMutation.onError when Purchases.purchasePackage throws 'identity_not_ready' — the underlying purchase call itself will validate. The 'identity_not_ready' guard in purchaseMutation (revenuecat.tsx:63) can also be softened for web/test-store (Platform.OS === 'web' || __DEV__).
After the fix, retest the FULL flow: tap subscribe → confirm-ok → wait ~5s → verify (a) paywall closes, (b) profile 'Premium actif', (c) chat shows chat-input, (d) club shows ann-content-input.

Verify chat-premium-lock manually by seeding at least one conversation for marc (or start one via the 'Contacter' button on a player profile). Currently marc has 0 conversations so the lock composer can't be exercised via UI.
critical_code_review_comments: revenuecat.tsx:76-77 — deriving identityReady from customerInfo.originalAppUserId is fragile: on purchases-js Test Store, logIn() does not always update originalAppUserId synchronously in the returned customerInfo. Better source of truth is the app-level auth user + a boolean flag set after logIn resolves.

_layout.tsx:39-42 — the code correctly awaits Purchases.logIn(user.id) and pushes customerInfo into the react-query cache, BUT the customerInfo it received still has anonymous originalAppUserId (confirmed by the console log). So the cache-priming trick does not solve the identityReady gating in this environment.
paywall.tsx:113-114 — `disabled={isPurchasing || !identityReady}` is the exact line that blocks the CTA. Once identityReady is fixed, this becomes safe.

chat/[id].tsx:120-145 — gating implementation is correct: isSubscribed branch renders chat-input, else chat-premium-lock. Same pattern in club/[id].tsx:187-222 for ann-content-input / ann-premium-lock. Both look sound.
Confirm modal wiring (paywall-confirm-ok → doPurchase) looks correct — currently unreachable via UI because the trigger button is disabled.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Console log to look for: `[RevenueCat] identity bound: $RCAnonymousID:...` — as long as this shows an $RCAnonymousID prefix, identityReady is broken and the subscribe button will stay disabled. Verify the fix by (1) checking the button's computed opacity is 1.0 and Pressable is not disabled, (2) hint 'Préparation de ton compte…' is gone, (3) tapping subscribe opens the confirm modal, (4) tapping paywall-confirm-ok completes the Test Store purchase within ~5-8s (watch for customerInfo update event), (5) paywall router.back() fires, (6) profile premium-card text becomes 'Premium actif' + 'Messagerie et annonces débloquées', (7) chat/[id] shows chat-input instead of chat-premium-lock, (8) club/[id] Annonces tab shows ann-content-input instead of ann-premium-lock.
rca_of_issue: RCA: On the RevenueCat purchases-js Test Store (used by the web preview), calling `Purchases.logIn(userId)` returns a CustomerInfo whose `originalAppUserId` remains prefixed with `$RCAnonymousID:` (observed value `$RCAnonymousID:2cd4c02e5a684262887d64f4fe25115f`). The `useSubscription()` hook computes `identityReady = !!originalAppUserId && !originalAppUserId.startsWith('$RCAnonymousID:')` from that customerInfo, which therefore evaluates to false forever. The Paywall's subscribe button uses `disabled={isPurchasing || !identityReady}` (paywall.tsx:113), so the CTA is greyed-out with opacity 0.6 and the 'Préparation de ton compte…' hint (paywall.tsx:123-125) is shown. Because the button is disabled at the Pressable level (RN's onPress is short-circuited when disabled=true), no confirm modal opens and no purchase can be attempted. Reproduction: (1) open the preview URL, (2) login marc@padel.fr / password123, (3) tap Profile tab → tap the 'Passe Premium' card, (4) observe the button below the $79.99 price card is faded, un-tappable, and the small grey text 'Préparation de ton compte…' is visible right under it. Mitigation options are listed in action_items.
